name: Takazaki Eru
source:
Hobbies: Watching DVDs, browsing the internet
Skills: She can rotate her head enough to put an owl to shame
Likes: [url=/c17298]Saku[/url], red kidney beans, okonomiyaki with beans
Dislikes: People who badmouth Saku, creases in posters

A 5th-year student and the youngest of the Crowns, she works as their secretary. Formerly known as "Saku's personal chevalier," a title that didn't mean much more than explain her status as a self-designated servant, she still thinks of herself as Saku's knight in shining armor.

Cool-headed to the point of being near-expressionless most of the time, Eru calls herself the Crowns' most brilliant tactician. To her, Saku is love, Saku is life, and anyone who disagrees is not fit to live. Naturally, she absolutely loathes [url=/c17297]Shinri[/url] for daring to oppose Saku. She's ever ready to pounce on the opportunity to put him six feet under.

She can be extremely harsh to people she dislikes, and her sharp words are made even worse by the icy expression that usually accompanies them. Absolutely adores red kidney beans, and if anyone dares to make fun of them, she'll turn them into a beanbag. In case you couldn't tell, she's quite the eccentric herself. Seeing as she's flatter than freshly paved ground, Shinri could not possibly be less interested in her peerless booblessness.

"I, Eru Takazaki, have a flawless plan. Your next opponent shall be me, the Crowns' most brilliant tactician."

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
